name: Berzite
description: Berzite was a planet in Wild Space's Yost system that, in 3 BBY, was blockaded by the Galactic Empire in anticipation of rebel activity. As the rebel Phoenix Cell searched for a location for their new base, they initially declared one of Berzite's moons as a viable option until the astromech droid Chopper and his new ally AP-5 alerted them of the Imperial blockade there.
